name_input: TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICE; M/S TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES LTD; TCSL; TATA CONSULTANACY SERVICES LIMITED; M/S TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES LIMITED; TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICE LTD.; TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICE LIMITED; TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES LTD.; TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES LTD.; TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES LTD; M/S TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES LTD.; Tata Consultancy Services Limited
export_evidence: ImportKey page for slug 'tata-consultancy-services' (9 records total, 2 trading partners, 5 port lanes) shows outbound India-origin records, e.g. exact line: "2026-02-25 TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES LIMITED TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES G1 EDU-U5: UNITREE G1 HUMANOID ROBOT + ACCESSORIESMN (FOC)- DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India NOTTINGHAM EAST MID, UNITED KINGDOM 84795000 1017107" and "2025-10-07 TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES LIMITED TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES LENOVO THINK PAD MODEL 20N6. SN:PF1CN5R320/03 Banglore Air Cargo, India FRANKFURTMAIN INTL, UNITED KINGDOM 84713090 7714426". Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 9 Records detected"; rows actually visible on the free view = 5 (dates 2026-02-25, 2026-02-24, 2025-10-07, 2025-08-05, 2025-01-10). Note: 3 of those 5 rows are third-party consignments (NUTS DELISH PRIVATE LIMITED -> TATA TEA gift sets to Singapore, HS 09023020, BOL 9958939; DAGART SOLUTIONS -> 3D model to Paris, HS 90230010, BOL 7194920), so only 2 rows are genuinely TCS-originated exports.
domestic_evidence: Domestic supply is evidenced by the same customs dataset in the inbound direction: ImportKey slug 'tata-consultancy-services-limited' reports "Total Shipments 11802 Records detected", "Trading Partners 126", "Ports 91", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28", with TCS as Indian consignee/buyer of goods delivered into India, e.g. exact line: "2026-02-28 MCMASTER-CARR SUPPLY COMPANY, TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES LIMITED HARDWARE (NUT) -316 Stainless Steel High-Profile Nylon-Insert Locknut, M8 x 1.25 mm Thread,DIN 985, Packs of 25 / LOCKHARDWARE (NUT)- NEW YORK, CHINA SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India 73181900 7800573". Source counter: 11802 stated vs 5 rows visible on free view. This confirms large-scale physical goods intake into Indian ports (Sahar Air Cargo ACC INBOM4, Bangalore Air, Delhi Air Cargo) but is procurement, not domestic sales; GST turnover band and GeM/CPPP contract awards could not be retrieved (web_search backend returned 'Connection refused' on both attempts; volza/eximpedia/trademo returned HTTP 403), so GST band and tender values are null.
note: TCS is an IT-services company, not a hardware trader. Declared HS 847340 (parts of office/accounting machines) does not match any observed record: actual observed HS codes are 84795000 (industrial robots), 84713090 (laptops), 73181900/73181500/73181600 (fasteners), 85369090 (test points), 90230010 (scale models), 09023020 (tea gift sets). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual codes above and verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. Export evidence is real but thin and mostly one-off/FOC (free-of-charge) consignments: 2 TCS-originated rows (UK, 2025-10-07 and 2026-02-25) out of 9 total records; the bulk of the 11,802-record footprint is imports into India, i.e. TCS as buyer. No GST turnover band, no GeM/CPPP tender award and no annual-report geographic revenue split could be verified within the tool budget — those fields are null, not estimated. No sanctions/court/ownership issues were assessed here (out of scope for this role).
